title: Raat Di Gaddi
prompt: energetic Punjabi pop, driving dhol and tumbi groove, punchy 808 bass, bright synth brass hooks, festive dance-floor energy, confident male vocals with gang chants, glossy modern desi club production
lyrics:
[verse]
Raat di gaddi chal payi hai
Shehar diyan battiyan jagmagaan
Turn it up, we own the night
Dil vich beat, paira vich chaal
[chorus]
Nach le nach le saari raat
Dhol te tumbi, kamaal di baat
Hands up high, feel the light
Raat di gaddi, hold on tight
